validationScope: Author tests and final build/typecheck ran against the concurrent working tree, not an isolated clean whole-repository HEAD. Root integration was not edited by this leaf. No broad unrelated suites were run or fixed.
historicalAuthorObservations: Initial core suite: 11/11 before later cases were added.
Initial safety suite: 52/54; corrected an author directory-header permission fixture and moved unsupported-link validation before parent creation; subsequent 54/54 before later cases.

Initial native suite: 4/5 because the author wrongly assumed GNU deferred forward hardlinks. Native status 2 was frozen in native-followup.json; corrected the test, not the already-rejecting product behavior.

One intermediate text-budget test failed after bounded diagnostics were introduced; diagnostics received their own explicit maxDiagnosticBytes limit rather than silently bypassing an undocumented bound.
An early global typecheck included an unrelated src/commands/table-text/comm.ts Uint8Array generic error. This leaf did not modify it; final fresh whole-tree typecheck passed after concurrent work.

First 128-test run: 127/128. Tar preserved a leading BOM in filename/listing bytes, but the shared Shell stdout text decoder removed it. The exact-byte assertion was corrected to stdoutBytes and the shared text behavior is documented, not patched here.

sharedOwnerObservation.scope: Shell result text decoding, not archive framing
sharedOwnerObservation.repro: List an archive whose first member is U+FEFF + 'file'. ShellResult.stdoutBytes begins EF BB BF 66 69 6C 65 0A, while ShellResult.stdout is 'file\n'.
sharedOwnerObservation.effect: Archive bytes and extracted filename are preserved. Text consumers must use stdoutBytes for exact leading-BOM behavior.
